text_block_list.text:
After spending the day out with Super
Creek, I
head over to the library.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I've been taking it easy as I study
different
training methods—just as I
promised to Super
Creek. Then one
day...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We did it, Trainer! My time has
improved!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list:
It's because you've been working so hard,
Creek!

text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad all our hard work is paying
off. Hehe!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Look, Trainer. Over there...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... Trainer... I-I'm sorry I can't manage... a better time...
text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
It's not your fault. It's mine for lacking
the power
to support you as a trainer.
text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer

text_block_list.text:
Let's call it a day. I'll think of a new
training plan
for next time.
text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer

text_block_list.text: Then, um... I'll also...
text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Actually, never mind... Thank you for
today.
text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume

text_block_list.text: It's that trainer from before.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Sigh... What do I even do? This is all my fault. At this rate, she—
text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
choice_data_list: You should talk to her some more.

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me? And who asked for—oh, it's
you two...
You were listening?
text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer

text_block_list.text:
Sorry. We happened to overhear your

conversation.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Still... I agree with my trainer.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
This is none of your business. It's my own
inability
that's to blame. I don't intend
to point any fingers
at my trainee.
text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer

text_block_list.text:
Well, we're making it our business. I just
want to
tell you that you're wrong.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she's worried about you and
wants to talk
with you about it, just like I
do with my trainer.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
She wants to better understand your
hardships
and share them with you.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: ...My hardships?
text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer

text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm sure of it.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: But I could never put that on her...
text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
choice_data_list: Some things can't be solved on your own.

text_block_list.text:
If you two gain a deeper understanding
of each
other, you might also be able to
find a solution to
your problems.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
She isn't just an athlete whose sole
purpose is to
run—Umamusume are more
than that.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. You might be right. Thanks. I'll
start by
trying to talk to her.
text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer

text_block_list.text:
And... I'm sorry for all the mean things I
said
before.
text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer

text_block_list.text:
I think our little talk with that other
trainer...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Will help her to form a good relationship
with her
Umamusume—just like the one
we have.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
You really are kind. Who's a good
Тренер?! Yes,
you are! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
While it's important to share a bond, I
feel like
I'm being spoiled a bit too
much. I need to reflect
on my actions.
From now on...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: I won't allow myself to be spoiled anymore!
I will become a more dependable trainer!
I'll be the one doing the pampering!

text_block_list.text:
While it's important to share a bond, I
feel like
I'm being spoiled a bit too
much. I need to reflect
on my actions.
From now on...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: I won't allow myself to be spoiled anymore!
I will become a more dependable trainer!
I'll be the one doing the pampering!

text_block_list.text: Huuuuh? But why?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
No... I can't bear the thought of no
longer being
able to pamper you...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
It's just too sad... Too lonely... It's
making me
cry...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: I won't be able to work hard during training... Sniffle.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. If you become any more reliable, I
won't be
able to take care of you any
longer.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Still, I know there are people out there
who don't
know how truly reliable you
are.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I'll just have to show my trainer off to
the world
through my races.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Goodness gracious! You? Pampering
me? That
must mean...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
You'll let me spoil you to the moon and
back,
right?!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Hehehe, that makes me so happy.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Always such a sweet little cutie, aren't
you? I'll
keep spoiling you rotten! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I panic and take back what I had just
said, only to
notice a cheeky grin
spreading across Super
Creek's face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I try to say otherwise, but Супер Крик
pretends
not to hear me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I can't wait for the day when everybody
discovers
how incredible you are! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
